Name: Cleaner Cellar 1.6
Author: Kazooo
Description:
After you buy the third farmhouse upgrade, the cellar already looks dilapidated.
This mod makes it so the cellar doesn't look dilapidated. 
This is a 1.6 continuation of [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/IndiePhunq/mods?gameId=1303]IndiePhunq's[/url] Cleaner Cellar [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3910]mod[/url].
For stardew 1.5 and below use that one. 

Has a config:
Barrels = true (default) / false : if set to false removes the decorative barrels from the cellar
Pillars = true (default) / false : if set to false removes the decorative pillars from the cellar
